description: A type-level `transitions {}` rule carries a `given (...)` guard. Per §51.2 type-level transitions are structural only, so the guard is rejected with E-ENGINE-010 (§34: Error) and the rule is parsed with the guard discarded.
rationale: §51.2 — a type-level `transitions {}` block carries STRUCTURAL rules only (VariantRef => VariantRef). A `given` guard is contextual: it reads state outside the type, so it cannot belong to a declaration that travels with the type itself. Guards live on a `< machine>` declaration, which has a scope to evaluate them in.
